description: HSTS forces browsers to use HTTPS for this host, mitigating SSL-stripping attacks.
CSP restricts which sources scripts/styles/frames may load from, mitigating XSS impact.
Prevents the page from being embedded in a hostile iframe (clickjacking).
Prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from its declared content type.
Controls how much referrer information is leaked to other origins on navigation.
Restricts which browser features/APIs (camera, geolocation, etc.) the page may use.
